# MESQUAL

> mesqual is an open-source Python framework for multi-scenario analysis of energy market simulations. It compares, visualizes and analyzes results across scenarios and modeling platforms. Its API is made for humans and agents alike: anyone can understand, navigate and analyze a study.

Install: `pip install mesqual`

## Docs

- [Documentation for humans and agents](https://docs.mesqual.io/llms.txt): the llms.txt of the mesqual docs
- [Use mesqual with agents](https://docs.mesqual.io/use-with-agents/): install the skill with `python -m mesqual.skills install .` (add `--claude` for Claude Code)
- [Source code](https://github.com/helgeesch/mesqual)
